title: Thanh Van Mon Episode 15: The Girl With a Hundred Names
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: She finds a girl in the garden who has been given a new name every day for a hundred years. The girl knows everyone's secret identities.
concept.story_arc: Hidden alcove found, The nameless girl, The list of a hundred names, Secret identities revealed, Her offer

shots.prompt: Medium shot — deep in the overgrown corner of the garden, behind a curtain of hanging willows, she discovers a small clearing. A girl no older than fifteen sits on a stone bench, surrounded by dozens of name plaques — each carved with a different name. She is weaving a new plaque as she hums. She does not look up. Camera: medium shot through willow curtain, her discovering the girl weaving name plaques. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — through willow curtain to girl weaving name plaques in hidden clearing, 6s
shots.narration: Behind the curtain of willows, there was a girl who had been given a new name every day for a hundred years. She had no real name. She had a hundred.
shots.sfx: Willow rustling, humming, knife carving wood, bird call, soft wonder

shots.prompt: Close-up — the girl finally looks up. Her eyes are silver-white — the eyes of someone who sees what others cannot. She gestures to the plaques. She begins reading: Yesterday you were called Thu Huong. Today you are called Mai Linh. Tomorrow you will be called Bao Ngoc. She smiles slightly. I know everyone's real name. The ones the palace erased. Camera: extreme close-up on the girl's silver eyes as she reveals her knowledge. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — girl's silver-white eyes, reading her list of erased names with perfect memory, 6s
shots.narration: She had been given a new name every day for a hundred years — so the palace thought she had no identity to protect. Instead, she had used those names to track everyone else's erased identities. Brilliant cover. Cruel training.
shots.sfx: Soft voice speaking names, plaque tap, heartbeat, mystery swell, whisper

shots.prompt: Medium shot — the girl pulls out a scroll — impossibly long, unrolling across the entire clearing. Names and dates. Hundreds of entries. She points to one: Thuong Khue — ruled one night as Empress. She points to another: General Vuong Phuc — erased after the Night of Crimson Silk. Another: Your mother. Erased seventeen years ago. She looks up. Camera: medium shot of her frozen as the scroll reveals her mother's erased identity. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — endless scroll unrolling, girl's finger on her mother's erased name, her shock, 6s
shots.narration: The scroll was a map of everything the palace had destroyed. And there — third from the bottom of the last column — her mother's name. Erased. Seventeen years ago. But not forgotten.
shots.sfx: Scroll unrolling, name spoken aloud, sharp breath, emotional strings, revelation

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the girl stands. She is shorter than expected but her presence fills the clearing. The Emperor has been erasing names for three hundred years. He started with his rivals. Then his failures. Then his embarrassments. Now he erases anyone who threatens him. She offers the scroll. You want to restore the names? I'll show you how. But it will cost you your title. Camera: wide shot, the short girl commanding the clearing, offering the scroll. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — girl standing, commanding presence, offering the impossible scroll of erased names, 6s
shots.narration: A hundred years of falsified names — and she had used them all to document the truth. Now she offered that truth to the only person brave enough to carry it.
shots.sfx: Scroll offered, wind stopping, heartbeat, epic resolve, determination

shots.prompt: Close-up — she takes the scroll. The girl's silver eyes soften for the first time. My real name, she says quietly, was Linh. I was four when they started giving me fake names. She smiles. After tonight — you can call me Linh again. Camera: cinematic close-up on both their faces, the scroll in her hands, the garden lanterns glowing behind them. 6 seconds. End on their hands touching over the scroll.
shots.camera: Close-up — her taking scroll, girl's soft smile revealing her real name is Linh, garden glowing, 6s
shots.narration: A girl without a name for a hundred years — finally ready to be called Linh again. And with that scroll, she could restore every name the palace had ever erased.
shots.sfx: Scroll taken, breath released, wind warm, name spoken, hopeful strings ending
